privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information the Sync Sirius website collects from demo requests and contact submissions, how that information is used, and how visitors from Brazil and California can exercise privacy rights.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
body: Website forms collect personal/contact and inquiry fields only: name, email, company, phone, role, GDS system, message, contact subject or service selection, and the active submission locale where applicable.
We do not collect payment information, GDS credentials, or booking records through this website.

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUse.body: We use submitted information to respond to demo requests, answer contact inquiries, understand which Sync Sirius service you asked about, maintain a record of the conversation, and support follow-up in the language used for the submission.

storageAccess.title: Storage and Access
storageAccess.body: Lead data is stored in secured SQLite and is accessible only through authenticated, admin-only access for authorized Sync Sirius users.

dataRetention.title: Retention and Deletion
dataRetention.body: Demo request and contact lead data is retained for 24 months from the submission date, then deleted. You may request earlier removal using the privacy contact below.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: At MVP, this website uses no analytics or tracking cookies. Only functional cookies or local storage values needed for site operation, such as language preference, are in scope.

gdsData.title: GDS Credentials and Product Data
gdsData.body: GDS credentials are never collected by this website. SyncRevenue product integrations are separate from website lead collection and are handled through separately scoped customer agreements and product data flows.

lgpdRights.title: LGPD Rights for Brazil
lgpdRights.body: Brazilian visitors may request confirmation of processing, access to their information, correction, deletion or removal, portability or information about use where applicable, and details needed to exercise rights under LGPD.

ccpaRights.title: CCPA Rights for California
ccpaRights.body: California residents may request to know what personal information was collected, access it, correct it, delete it, and receive information about how website lead data is used under CCPA.
